//: Functions run in Sydney because the Supabase project is in ap-southeast-2.
Co-locating them removes roughly a second of cross-Pacific latency per
page, which was the main cause of admin pages taking 5-10 seconds.
This is not the long-term answer. The database belongs in London
(eu-west-2) for UK clients and UK data residency, but Supabase's free
tier allows two active projects per user and both slots are in use, one
of them by a live product with real users. Move the database to London
and delete this file once a slot frees up or the account is upgraded.
The public marketing pages are statically prerendered and served from
Vercel's edge regardless of this setting, so UK visitors are unaffected.
Only the admin, portal and lead API run in Sydney.
